digest.component_or_area: completion verifier budget and verdict caching
propositions: Verifier step budget exhausts on legitimate validation, incorrectly marking valid criteria as unmet despite sufficient tool use within allocated bounds.
Current budget formula (steps_per_criterion * count, clamped 480) lacks evidence-surface scaling for epic children and fixed overhead, causing underprovisioning on multi-criteria tickets.
Repeated re-verification cycles re-prove all criteria without cross-run retention of validated PASS verdicts, wasting ~10 min per exhaustion retry.
Budget design intent is runaway prevention only; runaway is already separately guarded (tool_calls_limit, loop detection), so artificially low budgets add false failures without safety benefit.

Cached PASS verdicts persisted at ticket scope with scoped content fingerprint (git blob SHAs of file_impact paths) must survive worktree refresh and unrelated commits but invalidate on in-scope file changes or criterion text edits.
